turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! We'll do one example together first.
I walk to school every day. She walks to school every day.
Step 1: Find the person. It is "she".
Step 2: Add -s to the verb: walk becomes walks.
Rule: after he, she or it, put -s or -es on the verb.
Right: He reads in bed. Wrong: He read in bed.

Now you. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
